His mother calls anxiously to him: “Spring, spring to your heart’s content, but beware of flying! It’s not for you to fly!” And his living father warned him as well: “In the earth lies the force that will thrust you upward. Touch it with only your toe, you'll have the strength of that son of earth, 安泰俄斯.” And so he leaps, like a batted ball, from one massive rock face to another, bouncing freely every which way. Then all at once he vanishes down a savage ravine and seems lost to us forever. Mother weeps; father comforts; and I shrug my shoulders, concerned and anxious. Then suddenly he’s there again! Ah, what a sight! Has he found treasures buried down there? He’s dressed now in flowered robes, tassels dangling from his arms, ribbons fluttering at his breast, and like a miniature 阿波罗, with golden lyre in hand, cheerfully approaches the edge of the precipice above us. Wonderful! His parents embrace in delight. What glory is it shines about his head? A halo? It’s hard to say. A golden ornament?

妈妈焦急地叫他：“春天，尽情地春天吧，但要小心飞翔！不是让你飞的！”他活着的父亲也警告他：“大地里蕴藏着将你向上推的力量。只要用你的脚趾触碰它，你就会拥有大地之子安泰俄斯的力量。”于是他像一颗被击中的球一样，从一个巨大的岩石表面跳到另一个岩石表面，自由地弹跳到各个方向。然后他突然消失在一个蛮荒的峡谷里，我们似乎永远迷失了。母亲哭泣；父亲安慰；我耸耸肩，既担心又焦虑。然后突然他又出现了！啊，多么壮观啊！他是否发现了埋藏在下面的宝藏？他现在身着花袍，臂上挂着流苏，胸前飘扬着丝带，就像一个微型阿波罗，手里拿着金色的七弦琴，欢快地走近我们头顶的悬崖边缘。精彩的！他的父母欣喜地拥抱在一起。他的头上闪耀着怎样的荣耀？光环？很难说。金色的装饰品？
